record.field: UAE MoJ Notice 247/2026 — joint guidance on the AML/CFT/CPF Compliance Officer

Joint MoJ / MoET / Central Bank / SCA guidance on the AML/CFT/CPF Compliance Officer, referencing Article 22 of Cabinet Resolution 134/2025. Section 4.2: the CO/MLRO role and the entire compliance function must not be outsourced under any circumstances. Specific tasks may be outsourced only after obtaining a Letter of No Objection (LNOO) from the supervisory authority. "System Support" is listed among the examples of an outsourced task. An Alternate CO/MLRO is required. Both officers pass a fit-and-proper test on integrity, qualifications, experience, skills, and a documented professional path. Where CO/MLRO duties sit with someone holding other responsibilities, that person must not have day-to-day responsibility for sales or customer relationship management.
Primary source. Used by: sgc_tenant_readiness (CO/MLRO + Alternate + fit-and-proper + LNOO field + segregation mixin).
UAE MoET DNFBP Guidelines, March 2026 — Real estate DNFBP companion guidance

Real-estate-specific companion to MoJ Notice 247/2026. Records of qualification assessments and background verification must be maintained. The CO/MLRO appointment is notified to the supervisory authority. The fit-and-proper test includes integrity attestation (no criminal record, no regulatory action, no disqualification).
Primary source. Used by: sgc_tenant_readiness (appointment notification field, fit-and-proper integrity attestation).
Cabinet Resolution 134/2025, Article 22 — CO/MLRO report cycle
At least once every six months, to senior management and to the supervisory authority upon request

The CO/MLRO must submit a report on the adequacy and effectiveness of the AML/CFT/CPF programme to senior management at least once every six months, and to the supervisory authority upon request. Used by: sgc_tenant_readiness → G29 (bi-annual CO/MLRO report, Wave 3).
Cabinet Decision 74/2020, Article 21 — Sanctions Compliance Program

Sanctions Compliance Program obligation. Distinct from AML screening. Targeted Financial Sanctions (TFS) list must be checked; freeze / unfreeze orders from the supervisory authority must be implemented. The supervisory authority's Appendix-1 deficiency list flags "no or limited oversight over the implementation of search and freeze/unfreeze orders received from the FIU." Used by: Wave 2 item 5 extension → G30 (TFS freeze workflow).
UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 — Personal Data Protection (PDPL)

Personal Data Protection Law. Establishes controller / processor distinction. In a multi-tenant deployment, the tenant is the controller; we are the processor. Processor duties attach to our architecture, not to tenant conduct. Used by: sgc_tenant_readiness (G27 PDPL processor obligations).
